scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.db:status: uv run --project backend python scripts/database.py status
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --project backend python scripts/database.py upgrade
scripts.db:test: uv run --project backend python scripts/database.py test
scripts.db:app-role: uv run --project backend python scripts/database.py app-role
scripts.db:audit: uv run --project backend python scripts/database.py audit
scripts.api:generate: uv run --project backend python scripts/contracts.py && pnpm --dir tools/contracts generate
scripts.api:check: uv run --project backend python scripts/contracts.py --check && pnpm --dir tools/contracts check
scripts.worker: cd backend && uv run celery -A app.tasks.celery_app:app worker --pool=prefork --concurrency=2 --loglevel=WARNING --without-gossip --without-mingle
scripts.beat: cd backend && uv run celery -A app.tasks.celery_app:app beat --loglevel=WARNING --schedule celerybeat-schedule
